title: 20 Years Later, Shonen Jump Fans Are Still Waiting for This Anime to Return
content:
There’s no denying that when it comes to Shonen series, supernatural fantasies will always grab all the spotlight. One of the most standout original series of Weekly Shonen Jump is D.Gray-man , written and illustrated by Katsura Hoshino. The manga began serialization in 2004, but it wasn’t long after the debut that it started facing several hiatuses due to Hoshino’s health issues . In April 2018, the series moved to the quarterly magazine Jump SQ. Rise, leading to a far slower trickle for new chapters. Furthermore, although the manga is still ongoing, the latest chapters are only available in Japan.

Official platforms such as Viz Media and Shonen Jump only have 245 chapters available. On the bright side, the newer chapters are available in the latest Volume 29, which was only released recently . It’s the first manga volume released in three years, which is all the more reason why fans are hyped for the new release. The manga is commemorating its 20th anniversary since it debuted on October 3rd, 2026. Even 20 years and several hiatuses later, the series still maintains a wide global fan base, which is all the more reason why the anime needs to return as soon as possible.

D.Gray-man Returned With a Disappointing Sequel 10 Years Ago

While the anime originally debuted in 2008, it was an ongoing show that released weekly episodes. It didn’t take long before the anime caught up with the manga until there was no new content for the animation studio to adapt. The anime wrapped up after 103 episodes, leaving its future uncertain. This is all the more reason why its comeback with D.Gray-man Hallow in 2016 was supposed to be a big deal. Fans were enthusiastic to watch the sequel to their beloved show, but it wasn’t what they expected at all. The sequel should have received more hype since it was expected to be more visually polished.

Unfortunately, not only was the animation underwhelming, but the sequel even suffered from rushed pacing and several changes from the manga. Even so, despite the long wait, the sequel was a massive flop, and even the home video release was cancelled by Aniplex later on. The anime hasn’t confirmed any sequel for over a decade, even though there are enough chapters since the manga returned from hiatus. The anime has covered around 200 chapters, and it ended at a crucial phase right before around the time the story was getting even more intense.

D.Gray-man Needs a Reboot More Than a Sequel

There’s no denying that at this point, the anime would do better as a reboot since the earlier chapters weren’t always adapted perfectly either. Not to mention that since Hallow was a massive flop, the chances of a sequel being released are next to none. The anime fails to capture the gritty details and the true essence of the story that actually made it special. Not only that, but the 2000s animation and the long-running format aren’t that attractive to newer viewers either, which is why it’s becoming increasingly difficult for the series to rise in popularity. With the anime industry growing rapidly, fans have all kinds of new anime as options that have flashy animation on top of having an exceptional story.

While Hallow was definitely one of the worst adaptations , the original anime wasn’t exceptional either. Since it followed a weekly schedule, it suffered from slow pacing and even fillers. Even so, the biggest reason why the anime needs a reboot is just so it can perfectly capture the tone of the story. The manga is a lot darker than the anime portrayed it to be, which only got more intense as the story continued. Hoshino’s art style continued to evolve, further highlighting the brutality of the world Allen was forced to live in.

The mangaka’s art is deeply inspired by Gothic architecture, religious iconography, and classical European influences, which didn’t hit the same in the anime since it failed to properly capture these elements due to production constraints. Even though it might be a risky gamble, there’s no denying that fans would be more interested in the reboot if another studio decides to pick it up. The manga has over 27 million copies in circulation, which is a huge milestone for any series. It’s even more impressive considering that these sales are recorded after several hiatuses.

Head down to the comments to tell us if you are excited for the anime to return, or should it get a brand new adaptation instead? Or you could tell us your favorite D.Gray-man moment.

title: Kagurabachi Expands New Anime Cast With Special Trailer – Watch
content:
Kagurabachi is undoubtedly one of the huge Shonen Jump anime debuts fans are keeping an eye out for next year , and now the case of the series is getting even bigger with a cool new teaser trailer showing it off. Takeru Hokazono’s Kagurabachi has been pretty much begging to get its own anime adaptation ever since it made its original debut a few years ago, and thankfully the wait for that debut will soon be over. But each new look at the series is making the wait for it seem tougher.

Kagurabachi has been steadily revealing information over the course of the past few months as it has been in the midst of a world tour for its first episode’s early premiere . But there are still many things being kept under wraps like the majority of the characters we’ll see in action. Though one new face has been revealed as Yuichi Nakamura (Satoru Gojo in Jujutsu Kaisen , Loki in One Piece ) is joining the cast as Soshiro Azami. Check out the special trailer for the character below.

Kagurabachi Anime Recruits Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami

As detailed by CyberAgent in a new press release, Yuichi Nakamura has officially joined the cast of Kagurabachi as Soshiro Azami. The character is described as as a sorcerer affiliated with the Kamunabi (and teased to be one of the “most formidable members”), and is one of the few who know of Chihiro’s existence. Nakamura even teases bit of Azami’s charm as a character with, “I think he’s a character whose appeal will become increasingly apparent as the story progresses .”

Nakamura joins an already stacked cast for Kagurabachi that currently includes the likes of Taihi Kimura as Chihiro Rokuhira, Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige Rokuhira, Katsuyuki Konishi as Togo Shiba, Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi, and Miku Ito as Hinao . It’s also been previously revealed that the new anime will be directed by Tetsuya Takeuchi for Cypic with Keigo Sasaki providing the character designs. But there’s still much that fans don’t know about the new anime’s production thus far. That will hopefully change soon enough.

When Does Kagurabachi Actually Come Out?

Kagurabachi will be making its debut on screens sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. While there is no concrete release date for the new anime as of this time, it has been revealed that it will be streaming with Crunchyroll when it arrives . There are still many details fans are hoping to get revealed in the coming months too such as the production staff that’s bringing all of it to life. There is an opportunity for some big updates very soon, however.

Kagurabachi has been announced as one of the many titles that Shueisha will be showcasing as part of the Jump Festa 2027 event later this year . Taking place over the December 19-20 weekend in Japan, this is going to be where we likely get the biggest update for the new anime’s progress as we head into 2027. There likely will be other opportunities to showcase more heading into December, but we’ll have to see how it shakes out.

How are you liking how Kagurabachi’ s anime is coming together so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Tokyo Revengers Returns With New Season 4 Opening & Confirms Episode Count
content:
Tokyo Revengers has kicked off the beginning of the end with Season 4, and has debuted a new opening while confirming how many episodes it’s going to be sticking around for. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has kicked off in full as fans are now going to be seeing a ton of new anime releases, but there are a number of blockbuster franchises returning for new sequels too . And for Tokyo Revengers , its return to screens is going to be a little more involved as it’s nearing the grand finale.

Tokyo Revengers has returned this Fall with the fourth season of the TV anime adapting Ken Wakui’s original manga series , and with it has started to take on the penultimate arc of that series. Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc reveals that Takemichi hasn’t quite saved everyone in the future, and now he’s about to start one of its most intense revisits to the past yet. You can check out the new opening and ending for the anime below.

How Many Episodes Does Tokyo Revengers Season 4 Have?

The new opening theme for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc is titled “IGNITE” as performed by JO1, and the new ending theme is titled “TRICK STAR” as performed by go!go!vanillas. The official website for the anime has also revealed that this new season of the series will be running for 13 episodes across three Blu-ray and DVD releases in Japan. This means that this fourth season will only be running for a single cour of episodes before it wraps up its run later this year , and that does raise a lot of questions about the future of the anime adaptation.

The War of the Three Titans Arc from Ken Wakui’s original Tokyo Revengers manga is the second to last arc of the series overall, and runs for 29 chapters. It’s entirely possible for the anime to adapt these chapters into this single cour of episodes without much issue, but then it raises questions about the final arc to come. This and the “Kanto Manji Arc” to follow make up the two halves of the final saga for the series, so we’ll have to see just how far this season goes before it’s all done .

How to Watch Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc

Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc is now officially streaming with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ in the United States as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule. It’s currently listed as the third season of the anime on the platform despite being the fourth season, and it has launched its English dub at the same time as the Japanese language release (which is a great sign for the rest of the season to come). And you’re going to want to catch up with it all before it kicks off the grand finale.

Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc sees Takemichi going back to the past once more, but at a different point in the timeline than he expected. Because while he thought he was finally able to get to the best future, it’s revealed that Mikey’s darkness very much becomes a real danger in the future that needs to be taken care of. Are you going to be checking out Tokyo Revengers ‘ new season? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New My Happy Marriage Trailer Confirms Return for New Netflix Episodes – Watch Now
content:
My Happy Marriage is coming back to Netflix with some special new episodes later this month, and a new trailer is showing off more of what to expect. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is kicking into high gear as a new wave of anime releases are now starting to make their respective premieres, and that includes a lot of franchises that are returning for new episodes too . But there’s one return that has largely been flying under the radar because it’s not a full new season of episodes.

My Happy Marriage is making its return later this month with some special new episodes taking place after the events of the second season . Because while the first two seasons ended up being a lot more intense than fans could have expected with a title invoking a happy marriage, it seems like these special episodes are going to be exploring more of the happy times for the main duo that fans have been looking out for. You can check out the new trailer for My Happy Marriage below.

My Happy Marriage Special Episodes Confirm Netflix Release Date

My Happy Marriage Special Episodes will be officially making their debut with Netflix on October 25th worldwide , and includes three episodes with stories not seen in the anime’s first two seasons so far. The special episodes brings back the production staff from the main TV anime as well with Takehiro Kubota directing for Kinema Citrus, Mika Tanaka and Ikuho Negi providing the scripts, Shoko Yasuda, Hikaru Sato, and Kuniyuki Ito providing the character designs, and Evan Call composing the music. But that’s not all of the returns either.

My Happy Marriage Special Episodes also brings back the voice cast from the main TV anime series with Reina Ueda as Miyo Saimori and Kaito Ishikawa as Kiyoka Kudo headlining the returns. This newest trailer for the anime’s return also reveals the new opening theme titled “Shiawasede Namidagaderunowa.” as performed by riria, and it joins the previously revealed new ending theme titled “Just before the Prelude 〜for me&you〜” as performed by Kashitaro Ito. Now it just remains to be seen what’s coming in these new episodes .

What’s So Special About My Happy Marriage?

The anime adaptation for Akumi Agitogi and Tsukiho Tsukioka’s My Happy Marriage light novel series made its debut back in 2023, but has picked up quite a traction in a relatively short time. The series focuses on a duo that was set to be married, but it’s not long before things get a lot more complicated (and action driven) than fans might have been expecting from a romantic drama. This twist of its nature is why it’s been such a hit, and why these new special episodes are a big deal.

Miyo and Kiyoka are heading closer to their eventual wedding date , and it’s clear that their respective feelings are getting deeper by the day. But there really hasn’t been a lot of time for them to just relax and kind of enjoy their lives, so thankfully these special episodes seem to offer that in spades. Make sure to catch up with all of My Happy Marriage with Netflix in the meantime, so what are you hoping to see from the new episodes? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments!

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Debuts New Trailer Ahead of Fall Release – Watch
content:
The creator behind Sword Art Online and much more has a whole new anime on the way, and fans are getting a fuller look at what to expect from Devils’ Crest ahead of its debut later this year. The Fall 2026 anime schedule of new releases is now underway as a new wave of shows are starting to make their debuts this month, but there’s one show in particular that’s going to make fans wait a little bit further until its own release. The hope is the wait will be worth it.

Reki Kawahara, who has been the creator behind major hits like Sword Art Online and Accel World , has a new series set to get its own TV anime adaptation debut this Fall . Devils’ Crest is his latest light novel series making the jump to screens, and it’s going to have a familiar story as a group of kids find themselves trapped within the deadly world of a virtual reality game they enjoy to play. You can check out the newest trailer for Devils’ Crest below.

When Does Devils’ Crest Come Out?

Devils’ Crest will be making its debut on November 6th as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and will be exclusively streaming worldwide with Prime Video when it hits. The new series will be directed by Kenichiro Komaya for Production I.G. with Shinji Ushiro serving as chief director, Eiji Umehara providing the scripts, Yuki Hayashi composing the music, and original light novel artist Yukiko Horiguchi providing the character designs. This new trailer also reveals the ending theme titled “ReaL.” as performed by Soala. The opening theme is titled “Evolution” as performed by Ado.

The voice cast for Devils’ Crest currently includes the likes of Haruka Shiraishi as Yuma Ashihara, Konomi Inagaki as Sawa Ashihara, Yuya Hirose as Kenji Kondo, Satomi Amano as Minagi Sano, Yusuke Kobayashi as Teruki Sugamo, Maaya Uchida as Aria Misono, Rie Murakawa as Kai Kisanuki, and Sora Amamiya as Sumika Watamaki. New additions to the voice cast revealed in this latest trailer are Atsushi Tamaru as Shin Haizaki and Ayumu Murase as Kakeru Niki. It won’t be too much longer until we see it in its full action, however.

What Is Devils’ Crest About?

Though Devils’ Crest seems like it’s going to be mirroring Sword Art Online , it thankfully is going in a much different direction. Because while both series see people suddenly trapped within a deadly video game world , Devils’ Crest has protagonists and characters that are much younger. These middles schoolers are thrown into some very dangerous situations as they now need to fight for their lives, and that makes it all the more compelling than what was seen in Sword Art Online .

But if you’re wanting more Sword Art Online instead, thankfully there is more in the works. Sword Art Online the Movie -Integral Domain- has been announced as a brand new feature film now in the works for a scheduled release in theaters across Japan sometime in 2028, but no real information has been revealed for the project yet outside of the fact that Yoshitsugu Matsuoka and Haruka Tomatsu are reprising their roles as the voices of Kirito and Asuna, respectively.

How are you liking the look of Devils’ Crest so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

These middles schoolers are thrown into some very dangerous situations as they now need to fight for their lives, and that makes it all the more compelling than what was seen in Sword Art Online .

But if you’re wanting more Sword Art Online instead, thankfully there is more in the works. Sword Art Online the Movie -Integral Domain- has been announced as a brand new feature film now in the works for a scheduled release in theaters across Japan sometime in 2028, but no real information has been revealed for the project yet outside of the fact that Yoshitsugu Matsuoka and Haruka Tomatsu are reprising their roles as the voices of Kirito and Asuna, respectively.
How are you liking the look of Devils’ Crest so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Science Notes by Delta and Gamma Light Novels Get Anime
content:
The " Dengeki Bunko Fall Festival Online 2026" announced on Saturday that Takuma Sakai 's The Science Notes by Delta and Gamma (Delta to Gamma no Rigakubu Note) light novel series is receiving an anime adaptation.

Kanna Nakamura voices Rio Iwama in the announcement video, which features art by the light novels' illustrator Asagi Tōsaka .

The artist for the manga adaptation of the series, Lap Tsutsumi , drew an illustration to celebrate the announcement.

The light novel series follows the activities of the Tsunagai High School's science club as they try to solve the mysteries that surround their daily lives, as welll as a story of first love.

Kadokawa shipped the first novel volume with illustrations by Asagi Tо̄saka in November 2024 and will ship the fourth novel on October 9.

Tsutsumi launched a manga adaptation of the series on Kadokawa 's Comic Dengeki DaiohG magazine on April 27.

Sakai launched the Butareba: The Story of a Man Turned into a Pig ( Buta no Liver wa Kanetsu Shiro ) novel series with illustrations by Tōsaka in March 2020, after winning the gold prize (effectively second place) in the 26th Dengeki Novel Prize in 2019. Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint is publishing the novels in print. Minami launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine in August 2020. J-Novel Club is releasing the novel series and the manga in English. The novels inspired a television anime that premiered in October 2023.

title: 5 Years Later, Black Clover Anime Returns With New Season 2 Opening – Watch
content:
After five long years of waiting, Black Clover has kicked off its Season 2 return in style with a new opening and ending theme showing off what’s coming our way. The anime adaptation for Yuki Tabata’s Black Clover wrapped up its first season back in 2021 after 170 episodes . Due to the anime nearing where Tabata’s manga was at the end, production had to be halted for the moment so that Tabata could make more of a distance between the two. Now that five year long wait is finally at an end.

Black Clover Season 2 has kicked off the Fall 2026 anime schedule as one of the most anticipated returns of the season (and likely of the year overall), and it’s getting things off to a very hot start with the debut of a new opening and ending theme for the series. Now that the new season has premiered in Japan, creditless versions of the new opening and ending theme sequences have been shared and you can check them both out in the videos below.

Black Clover Returns for Season 2 After Five Years

Black Clover ‘s new opening theme for Season 2 is titled “Kienai Riyu,” as performed by WANIMA, and the new ending theme is titled “Yellow Brick Road,” as performed by ONE OR EIGHT. Black Clover Season 2 has officially begun with its premiere episode as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, and fans will be able to find the new episodes streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia.

Black Clover Season 2 is directed by Ayataka Tanemura (the director behind Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King ) for Studio Pierrot, with Keiichiro Ochi overseeing the scripts, Itsuko Takeda handling the character designs alongside Kumiko Tokunaga, Kosei Takahashi handling prop design, and Minako Seki composing the music. The anime also features a returning voice cast for the first season, but any potential new additions to the voice cast have yet to be revealed as of this time. Either way, some big things are going down.

What Is Black Clover Season 2 About?

Black Clover Season 2 picks up immediately after that cliffhanger in the first season as Asta and the other Clover Kingdom Magic Knights have been training to make a raid on the Spade Kingdom. Needing to save Yami and Vangeance before they are sacrificed for the Advent of Qliphoth ritual, Asta needs to unlock a brand new power. But there are many other things to keep an eye on now that Yuki Tabata’s original manga story for it all has come to an end.

It’s yet to be revealed how long Black Clover Season 2 is going to stick around for, but there are only two more arcs left to cover before the anime reaches its adaptation of the grand finale. It might have taken 170 episodes to get to this point when the anime’s debut season ended back in 2017 , but that’s likely not going to be the case at all for these final two arcs. What are you hoping to see from Black Clover Season 2 this Fall? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Black Clover Season 2 Creditless Opening and Ending Videos Revealed
content:
Black Clover Season 2 anime has revealed its creditless opening and ending videos following the first episode’s October 3, 2026 premiere. Episode 1 is titled “War Begins,” with the synopsis and preview images were previously revealed.

The anime previously revealed the main trailer and theme song by rock band WANIMA, as well as confirmed that Ayataka Tanemura will return to direct the anime’s second season. Crunchyroll will stream the anime, and hosted an early screening for North America earlier this month.

You can watch the opening sequence below.

Also check out the creditless ending:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

The main visual was also recently revealed.

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: This Is the End Stagnation Committee Light Novels Have Anime in the Works
content:
The story imagines if our world is actually in the middle of an apocalypse, unbeknownst to most people. Weird creatures beneath Tokyo's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail perched on the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord who looks like a beautiful girl …. Yet, in the underbelly of society, there are boys and girls who fight the coming apocalypse while giving it the middle finger. They can't cancel the apocalypse, and they can only delay it. Still, they take their arms into battle. Why? To them, this is just day-to-day life, a ritual festival every day for the young.

Kadokawa published the first light novel volume with illustrations by Ogipote on July 10, 2025, and published the sixth volume on July 10, 2026. Hiroshi Sakurai began a manga adaptation on Kadokawa 's Shōnen Ace Plus service in April 2024, and Kadokawa published the second manga volume on July 10.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Season One Episode Titles Ahead of October Debut
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens is set to make its highly anticipated debut with Paramount+ later this month, and the sequel series has revealed the kind of episodes coming our way in this first season. Avatar: Seven Havens is a brand new expansion of the wider Avatar: The Last Airbender universe as Avatar Studios is moving the story hundreds of years forward from the end of The Legend of Korra . Introducing a new Avatar going through her own journey, there’s quite a lot of mystery surrounding this new era of the franchise.

Avatar: Seven Havens is only days away from its debut with Paramount+, and that means it won’t be long before fans can see what Pavi is up to as the next major Avatar after Korra. The series has been gearing up for its premiere by steadily revealing the titles for the episodes seen in its first season , and now it’s all been confirmed as they tease an intense story to come. You can get the full breakdown of Avatar: Seven Havens Book One episodes below.

Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Season 1 Episode Titles & Release Schedule

The full release schedule of Avatar: Seven Havens for Book One of the series breaks down as such:

October 9

• Chapter One – On the Horizon

• Chapter Two – Into the Storm

• Chapter Three – The Order

October 16

• Chapter Four – The Faceless

• Chapter Five – The One Left Behind

• Chapter Six – Night of the Afflicted

October 23

• Chapter Seven – What Lies Beneath

• Chapter Eight – The Envoys: Part One

• Chapter Nine – The Envoys: Part Two

October 30

• Chapter Ten – Ghosts and Spirits

• Chapter Eleven – Battle of the Ruins

• Chapter Twelve – The Dome

• Chapter Thirteen – The Root Chakra

When Avatar: Seven Havens was first confirmed for a release with Paramount+, it was also revealed that this new series would consist of 26 episodes in total. Spread across two different seasons, Book One of the series will be running for 13 episodes with Book Two then following with the second wave of 13 episodes. No release windows or dates have yet to be revealed for Book Two’s episodes as of this time, however.

When Does Avatar: Seven Havens Come Out?

As detailed by the release schedule, Avatar: Seven Havens will be officially making its debut with Paramount+ on October 9th with its first three episodes. Episodes 4-6 will then be released a few days later with the streaming service on October 16th, Episode 7-9 will then follow on October 23rd, and then the final Episodes 10-13 will be wrapping up the first season on October 30th. It’s sparked a ton of questions because not only does this series look nothing like the previous entries, it’s so far into the future that any immediate connections are not apparent.

Because it’s been confirmed to take place hundreds of years after the events of The Legend of Korra , it’s automatically raised all sorts of questions about what kind of Avatar that Korra became after the end of her series . It’s been teased that she ultimately caused a cataclysm that led to the end of the world, and Pavi is now the Avatar in a world where having such a position is no longer something to be proud of.

What are you hoping to see in Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ debut season? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
